status: Root source review complete; import also requires three completed full-language reviews.
review_scope: Main reviewer fully read all Chinese body paragraphs in this five-essay batch. Language reviewers separately read each complete assigned manuscript and Chinese source, repairing precise language issues while preserving every paragraph, argument, concrete example and limitation. Essay 08 paragraphs 43 and 54 explicitly include the older person's own wishes and privacy, and limit restored access to legitimate participation rather than treating family members as unconditional owners of information or decisions. Paragraph 54 carries the same qualification into the concrete quoted promise, following a Japanese/Korean review suggestion accepted by root. All eight editions are synchronized. These are ethical/philosophical essays, not personalized legal or medical advice; no exhaustive external empirical audit is claimed.

before_by_language.zh: 必要时，资源和决定通道应当恢复或交给更可靠的程序。
before_by_language.hant: 必要時，資源和決定通道應當恢復或交給更可靠的程序。
before_by_language.en: Where necessary, resources and decision channels should be restored or placed under a more reliable procedure.

edits.reason: 明确老人本人也是主体；恢复参与不等于无条件公开个人信息或密码。
edits.zh: 这些处理应先尊重老人的意愿和隐私，确认各人正当的参与权限。必要的信息获取、资源使用和参与决定的通道，应在这个范围内恢复，或交给更可靠的程序，而不是把老人自己的生活只当作家属之间的分配。
edits.hant: 這些處理應先尊重老人的意願和隱私，確認各人正當的參與權限。必要的資訊取得、資源使用和參與決定的通道，應在這個範圍內恢復，或交給更可靠的程序，而不是把老人自己的生活只當作家屬之間的分配。
edits.en: Any response should first respect the older person's wishes and privacy and establish each person's legitimate scope of participation. Access to necessary information, use of resources, and participation in decisions should be restored within that scope or placed under a more reliable process, rather than treating the older person's own life as something for family members alone to divide up.

before_by_language.zh: “我仍然认为现有居住安排不安全。但我不应以收走信息和密码迫使你同意。我会把访问恢复，之后我们把安全判断交给共同记录和外部专业意见。”
before_by_language.hant: “我仍然認為現有居住安排不安全。但我不應以收走資訊和密碼迫使你同意。我會把訪問恢復，之後我們把安全判斷交給共同記錄和外部專業意見。”
before_by_language.en: 'I still think the current living arrangement is unsafe. But I should not force your agreement by taking away information and passwords. I will restore access. Then we can base the safety assessment on shared records and outside professional advice.'

edits.reason: 将第43段的老人意愿、隐私和正当权限边界落实到具体承诺，避免恢复访问被误解为无条件分享全部信息和密码。
edits.zh: “我仍然认为现有居住安排不安全。但我不应以收走信息和密码迫使你同意。我会在尊重老人意愿和隐私、确认各人正当权限后，恢复应有的信息访问，之后我们把安全判断交给共同记录和外部专业意见。”
edits.hant: “我仍然認為現有居住安排不安全。但我不應以收走資訊和密碼迫使你同意。我會在尊重老人意願和隱私、確認各人正當權限後，恢復應有的資訊存取，之後我們把安全判斷交給共同記錄和外部專業意見。”
edits.en: 'I still think the current living arrangement is unsafe. But I should not force your agreement by taking away information and passwords. I will restore the access to information each person should have, while respecting the older person's wishes and privacy and confirming each person's legitimate role. Then we can base the safety assessment on shared records and outside professional advice.'
